name: Passanant i Belltall (Spain)
description: White field with the middle vertical third red charged with a white Maltese cross, and a red bar across each outer third.
history: The official flag of Passanant i Belltall is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with the second vertical third red charged with a white Maltese cross of width 1/5 of the length at the centre, and the other two thirds with a red bar; approved on 24 March 2009 and published in the DOGC on 21 April 2009, based on the arms of the town.

features.role: Maltese cross on the red third
short red bar on the hoist third
short red bar on the fly third
